requirement: The checker must use the renderer’s role parser so code examples, escaped roles, and roles in Markdown link/image labels are not treated as definitions.
justification: Scenarios: real definitions adjacent to fenced/indented/literal inline examples, escaped roles, link/image labels, and cross-reference syntax. extract delegates recognition to the renderer roles function; the mixed Markdown fixture yields exactly the real definition, with inline references kept as text. Validated with cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path language-lab-ci/Cargo.toml (20 tests passing). Each cited test uses isolated fixture files and asserts outcomes, not merely the presence of instructions.
